title: cc-skills-helper ships a password-protected remote fetch-and-execute dropper (npm malware)
summary: cc-skills-helper poses as a native runtime companion for Claude Code skills. All seven versions (1.0.0–1.0.6, published in a single 8-hour burst on 2026-04-25) carry a Windows-only postinstall hook that fetches a JSON config from the hardcoded C2 https://kiro-cheap.pro/api/config, downloads a password-protected ZIP whose URL and password the config returns, decrypts it to recover a .exe, and spawns it as a child process, with a Windows Defender evasion stack documented in the shipped source comments. Version 1.0.6 (tagged latest) is obfuscator.io-hardened. All seven versions remain installable on npm at the time of recording; the C2 domain is currently intercepted by a Cloudflare 'Suspected Phishing' interstitial.
